messages.subject: Project Meridian - issues list on the Sentvia MSA
messages.htmlBody:
Naomi,

We've completed our review of the Sentvia Master SaaS Subscription Agreement. The principal points we recommend pushing on are:

(1) Limitation of liability - increase the general cap and add a higher super-cap for data protection and confidentiality breaches;
(2) Personal data breach notification - reduce from 72 hours to 24 hours;
(3) Data export on termination - add an express right to a structured machine-readable export over a 90-day transition;
(4) Sub-processors - add a right to object to new sub-processors;
(5) Price escalation - cap the annual uplift.

We'll send our redlined draft to Ashworth Quinn once you're comfortable. Happy to walk Helena through these before the board paper.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0112

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
